scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns symmetric time-changed Brownian motion and equal long-run reset-event rates, not equal per-event expenditures.
It compares stationary position and increasing instantaneous occupation costs, not resetting work, first-passage time or entropy production.
No independent validation has been performed; unindexed general potential-comparison results remain a priority risk.
title: A one-crossing law for fair-rate threshold versus Poisson resetting
